findings.title: Review Rating Distribution (Jan 26 - Feb 2, 2026)
findings.claim: During the analysis period (Jan 26 - Feb 2, 2026), 17 reviews were collected with an average rating of 4.76 out of 5. Rating distribution: {3: 1, 4: 2, 5: 14}
assumptions: Rating values are valid integers between 1 and 5
All reviews in the specified date range are included

findings.title: Review Topic Analysis (Jan 26 - Feb 2, 2026)
findings.claim: Among 17 reviews analyzed (Jan 26 - Feb 2, 2026), keyword analysis identified topics in 7 reviews. The most frequently mentioned topics were: taste (4 mentions), service (2 mentions), price (1 mentions). Note: 10 reviews contained no extractable topics using the keyword matching approach. Analysis covered both English and Arabic text.
coverage_notes: Topic extraction method: keyword matching in English and Arabic
assumptions: Empty or missing review text is excluded from topic analysis
Keyword matching approach may miss nuanced or implicit topic references; manual validation of a sample is recommended to assess precision
Each review can contain multiple topics
